# Deployment script to create a release archive
# Excludes node_modules and .git directories

set -e  # Exit on any error

echo "Creating release archive..."

# Get the current directory name
DIR_NAME=$(basename "$(pwd)")

# Create timestamp for unique naming
TIMESTAMP=$(date +"%Y%m%d-%H%M%S")

# Define archive name
ARCHIVE_NAME="${DIR_NAME}-${TIMESTAMP}.tar.gz"

    --exclude='.gitignore' \
    --exclude='*.log' \
    --exclude='deploy.sh' \
    -czf "${ARCHIVE_NAME}" .

echo "Release archive created: ${ARCHIVE_NAME}"

# Optional: Show archive contents
echo "Archive contents:"
tar -tzf "${ARCHIVE_NAME}" | head -20
echo "..."

echo "Deployment archive ready!"

#!/bin/bash

# Deployment script to create a release archive
# Excludes node_modules and .git directories

set -e  # Exit on any error

echo "Creating release archive..."

# Get the current directory name
DIR_NAME=$(basename "$(pwd)")

# Create timestamp for unique naming
TIMESTAMP=$(date +"%Y%m%d-%H%M%S")

# Define archive name
ARCHIVE_NAME="${DIR_NAME}-${TIMESTAMP}.tar.gz"

# Create a temporary file to list files to archive

find . -type f \
  ! -path "./node_modules*" \
  ! -path "./.git*" \
  ! -path "./.*.log" \
  ! -path "./deploy.sh" \
  ! -path "./$ARCHIVE_NAME" > "$TEMP_LIST"

# Create the archive using the file list
tar -czf "${ARCHIVE_NAME}" -T "$TEMP_LIST"

# Clean up temporary file
rm "$TEMP_LIST"

echo "Release archive created: ${ARCHIVE_NAME}"
echo "Archive size: $(du -h "${ARCHIVE_NAME}" | cut -f1)"

# Optional: Show archive contents
echo "Archive contents (first 20 files):"
tar -tzf "${ARCHIVE_NAME}" | head -20
echo "..."

echo "Deployment archive ready!"

# Deployment script to create a release archive
# Excludes node_modules and .git directories

set -e  # Exit on any error

# Pre-deployment validation
validate_environment() {
  echo "Validating environment variables..."
  
  # Check if .env.test exists
  if [[ ! -f ".env.test" ]]; then
    echo "Warning: .env.test file not found. Skipping environment validation."
    return 0
  fi
  
  # Read each line from .env.test and check if the corresponding env var is set
  missing_vars=()
  while IFS= read -r line || [[ -n "$line" ]]; do
    # Skip empty lines and comments
    if [[ -z "$line" || "$line" =~ ^[[:space:]]*# ]]; then
      continue
    fi
    
    # Extract key (everything before =)
    key=$(echo "$line" | cut -d'=' -f1 | xargs)
    
    # Skip if key is empty
    if [[ -z "$key" ]]; then
      continue
    fi
    
    # Check if environment variable is set and not empty
    if [[ -z "${!key}" ]]; then
      missing_vars+=("$key")
    fi
  done < ".env.test"
  
  # Report results
  if [[ ${#missing_vars[@]} -eq 0 ]]; then
    echo "✓ All environment variables are set"
    return 0
  else
    echo "✗ Missing environment variables:"
    for var in "${missing_vars[@]}"; do
      echo "  - $var"
    done
    echo ""
    echo "Please set these variables before deployment."
    return 1
  fi
}

echo "Starting deployment validation..."
if ! validate_environment; then
  exit 1
fi

        echo "Warning: .env.test file not found. Skipping config send."
        return 0

    local json_content="{"
    local first_entry=true
    
    while IFS= read -r line || [[ -n "$line" ]]; do
        # Skip empty lines and comments
        [[ -z "$line" || "$line" =~ ^[[:space:]]*# ]] && continue

        local key=$(echo "$line" | cut -d '=' -f 1 | xargs)
        local value=$(echo "$line" | cut -d '=' -f 2- | xargs)
        
        # Skip if key is empty

        if [[ "$first_entry" == true ]]; then
            first_entry=false

            json_content="${json_content},"

        # Add key-value pair to JSON (properly escaped)

#!/bin/bash

# Deployment script to create a release archive
# Excludes node_modules, .git, and other release archives

set -e  # Exit on any error

# Pre-deployment validation: Check required environment variables
echo "Validating environment variables..."
if [[ -f ".env.test" ]]; then
    missing_vars=()
    while IFS= read -r line || [[ -n "$line" ]]; do
        # Skip empty lines and comments
        [[ -z "$line" || "$line" =~ ^[[:space:]]*# ]] && continue
        
        # Extract variable name (before = sign)
        var_name="${line%%=*}"
        
        # Check if variable is set and not empty in current environment
        if [[ -z "${!var_name}" ]]; then
            missing_vars+=("$var_name")
        fi
    done < ".env.test"
    
    if [[ ${#missing_vars[@]} -gt 0 ]]; then
        echo "Error: Missing required environment variables:"
        for var in "${missing_vars[@]}"; do
            echo "  - $var"
        done
        echo "Please set these variables before deploying."
        exit 1
    else
        echo "All required environment variables are set."
    fi
else
    echo "Warning: .env.test file not found. Skipping environment validation."
fi

echo "Creating release archive..."

# Get current timestamp for unique filename
